children: Chennai-based SWELECT Energy Systems Ltd is rolling out its SWEES EN+ hybrid inverter range for Commercial & Industrial (C&I) customers.
The range, available from 5 kW to 50 kW, is designed around the energy storage needs of businesses.
SWEES EN+ manages solar generation, battery storage and grid supply through a single system.

“With the BIS certification for our hybrid inverters, we are now rolling out the SWEES EN+ range from 5 kW to 50 kW, with a strong focus on the evolving energy requirements of C&I customers. The range has been designed with scalability at its core, enabling solutions to be configured in line with varying load profiles, operational requirements and future energy needs,” Arulkumar Shanmugasundaram, CEO & Managing Director, SWELECT Energy Systems, said.

title: SWELECT Energy Systems rolls out new inverter portfolio for commercial and industrial segment
